#Day21 #30DayChartChallenge: Timeseries - Historical
The adoption of the mobile phone in Europe

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
mobile <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2020/2020-11-10/mobile.csv')
landline <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2020/2020-11-10/landline.csv')
 
```

```{r}
mobile_clean <- mobile %>% mutate(phone_type = "mobile")
landline_clean <- landline %>% mutate(phone_type = "landline")
df <- bind_rows(mobile_clean, landline_clean)
```

```{r}
combined <- mobile |>
  inner_join(landline |> select(entity, code, year, landline_subs),
             by = c("entity", "code", "year")) |>
  filter(!is.na(continent), !is.na(mobile_subs), !is.na(landline_subs)) |>
  group_by(continent, year) |>
  summarise(mobile = median(mobile_subs, na.rm = TRUE),
            landline = median(landline_subs, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_longer(c(mobile, landline), names_to = "type", values_to = "subs")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

mobile <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/master/data/2020/2020-11-10/mobile.csv')
landline <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/master/data/2020/2020-11-10/landline.csv')

df_joined <- mobile |>
  inner_join(landline |> select(entity, code, year, landline_subs),
             by = c("entity", "code", "year"))

europe <- df_joined |>
  filter(continent == "Europe", !is.na(mobile_subs), !is.na(landline_subs)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(mobile = median(mobile_subs, na.rm = TRUE),
            landline = median(landline_subs, na.rm = TRUE))

crossover <- europe |> filter(mobile >= landline) |> slice_min(year) |> pull(year)
crossover_y <- europe |> filter(year == crossover) |> pull(mobile)

europe_pre  <- europe |> filter(year <= crossover)
europe_post <- europe |> filter(year >= crossover)
```
Plot
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
showtext_opts(dpi = 300)
font_add_google("Share Tech Mono", "sharetech")
showtext_auto()

p <- ggplot(europe, aes(x = year)) +
  # just the gap between curves - no fill from zero
geom_ribbon(data = europe_pre,
            aes(ymin = mobile, ymax = landline),
            fill = "#6B4C2A", alpha = 0.4) +
geom_ribbon(data = europe_post,
            aes(ymin = landline, ymax = mobile),
            fill = "#00A693", alpha = 0.4) +
# muted background above
geom_ribbon(data = europe_pre,
            aes(ymin = landline, ymax = 125),
            fill = "#6B4C2A", alpha = 0.06) +
geom_ribbon(data = europe_post,
            aes(ymin = mobile, ymax = 125),
            fill = "#00A693", alpha = 0.06) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mobile), color = "#00A693", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = landline), color = "#6B4C2A", linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate("point", x = crossover, y = crossover_y,
           size = 5, color = "#00A693") +
  #annotate("segment", x = crossover, xend = crossover,
   #        y = crossover_y + 20, yend = crossover_y + 5,
    #       arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), color = "gray40") +
 # annotate("text", x = crossover, y = crossover_y + 24,
  #         label = paste0("Mobile now dominates\n(", crossover, ")"),
  #         size = 3, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30") +
  annotate("text", x = 1991, y = 118,
           label = "Landline era", hjust = 0,
           size = 6, color = "#6B4C2A", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = crossover + 1, y = 118,
           label = "Mobile era", hjust = 0,
           size = 6, color = "#00A693", fontface = "italic") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1990, 2000, 2010, 2019),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 125)) +
  labs(
    title = "When Europe Hung Up on Landlines",
    subtitle = "Mobile overtook landlines in phone subscriptions in 2001",
    caption = "Source: OWID (#tidytuesday)\n #30DayChartChallenge Day 21 | Created by: Lyndsay Miles",
    x = NULL, y = "Subscriptions per 100 people"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18, base_family = "sharetech") +
theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 20, b = 10, l = 10),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 32),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 24, color = "gray40"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 16, color = "gray50"))

p

png("cc_2026_day21.png", width = 12, height = 8, 
    units = "in", res = 300)
print(p)
dev.off()
```
